scope: Part II Stage 05 normal — three object-boss comparisons using actual Part I references
generation_schedule: Stage01 and Stage05 ran as independent parallel jobs; within each stage the three concepts were generated sequentially. Maximum two image-generation calls at once.

images.concept_ko: 커다란 속 빈 아치와 버팀발 자체가 살아 있는 천구 하중 지지체. 천구가 지지홈에 얹히고 시침 창은 본체 측면의 강체 버팀부와 결합된다.

part1_references.role: Fixed-surface sculptural mass and cel materials; no exact body/face copy.
Living-object construction, hollow joints and large connected plates; no face/hair/layout copy.
Architectural palette/floor readability and restrained setting style only.

images.visual_qa: Visually inspected: no human anatomy or face; major arch buttresses, hollow core, fixed celestial saddles and side-clamped hour-hand spear define body. Complete celestial cage and spearhead inside frame, visible physical load contact. No floating sphere or minute-hand greatsword.

images.concept_ko: 기둥과 아치로 잠식된 몸에 석재 손과 한쪽 무릎만 흔적처럼 남았다. 빈 목 소켓 아래의 천구 지지구조와 시침 창이 하중을 받는다.

part1_references.role: Fixed-surface sculptural mass and cel materials; no exact body/face copy.
Living-object construction, hollow joints and large connected plates; no face/hair/layout copy.
Architectural palette/floor readability and restrained setting style only.

images.visual_qa: Visually inspected after one framing refinement: entire upper celestial arc now fully inside canvas with generous margin, alongside spear tip, hands and bases. Empty sealed neck socket, open arch torso, carved hand remnants and asymmetric kneeling/buttress supports. No human face, skin or hair.
images.refinement_reason: The first generation clipped the upper celestial ring. Camera was pulled back and the missing outer arc completed; only the corrected PNG is saved as final.

images.concept_ko: 무거운 짧은 다리와 낮게 숙인 봉인 투구를 가진 아틀라스 석상. 눈·얼굴 없는 면과 큰 고정 외피, 뒤의 버팀판으로 천구를 지탱하고 시침 창을 양손으로 붙잡는다.

part1_references.role: Fixed-surface sculptural mass and cel materials; no exact body/face copy.
Living-object construction, hollow joints and large connected plates; no face/hair/layout copy.

images.visual_qa: Visually inspected: small sealed polygonal face plate has no eyes, nose, lips or human expression. Heavy sculpted blocks and rigid rear buttress slabs dominate the silhouette. Celestial cage contacts shoulder/back saddles; complete single hour-hand spear and feet inside frame. No actor-like portrait or costume focus.

common_visual_qa: All three selected PNGs viewed. Actual Part I images were used in every initial generation. No previous Part II character image was used as an initial generation reference. No actual human portrait, eyes/pupils, fashion hair, realistic skin or costume-led character. Broad ivory/gold/navy sculptural masses, fixed surfaces, lavender cel shadows and coherent large support interfaces retained. No 3D mesh, UV, rigging or animation validation performed.
workspace_changes: Only this stage folder. Existing art, shared direction notes and other stage options preserved.
